== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Consultants]], also known as the [[Am’haranai]], are a highly efficient and reliable organization organized into a [[Guild]]. Members of this group are born on [[Gray Island]] and do not possess family names. They are characterized by a strict adherence to orders, whether those commands come from the Emperor, their clients, or the [[Council of Architects]]. While they are known globally as loyal servants to The Empire{{!}}the Empire who cannot be bribed or coerced, their primary motivation is a deep commitment to their contracts. [[The Guild]] is composed of various specialized roles: Shepherds focus on observation and infiltration; [[Masons]] specialize in undercover work; [[Gardeners]] handle removals; and [[Architects]], who serve as the ruling order, include diverse talents such as strategists, Alchemists{{!}}alchemists, and administrators. The [[Consultants]] are masters of information manipulation, sabotage, and spying, though they are less effective in direct combat. Although rumors exist regarding an order of assassins within the [[Guild]], their true identity is often difficult for outsiders to detect.}}
